preconditions.description: The number of knights n must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines must equal the number of initial knights n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(coord, int) for coord in [item for sublist in return_value for item in sublist])
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the output must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each coordinate (x, y) must be within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(coord) for coord in return_value)) == n
postconditions.description: All knights must be in different cells, i.e., no two knights can share the same coordinates.
The final number of knights must be at least floor(n^2 / 10).
